rooms.name: Immortal room 30100
rooms.desc:
You stand on a flowery grassland floating high above a forest.  Looking
over the edge of the piece of grassland, you can see a small clearing
in the forest canopy, and a small quaint garden.  Transparent stairs lead
into the clearing

rooms.name: Enterance to the Garden
rooms.desc:

hedges flank you to the east and west.  To the south is the forest.  
To the north you see a picturesque garden.  Tall multi-colored flowers
lie just inside the garden.  Farther to the north you see tall trees.

rooms.name: The Birdbath
rooms.desc:
You stand next to a small stone bird bath.  Little stone sculpted birds 
spray water into the polished stone basin.  The water looks cool and 
refreshing.  The garden path lies to the north and east.  To the south you
see oak trees.

rooms.name: Beneath the Oaks
rooms.desc:
You stand underneath the branches of a thick oak tree.  The coolness of the
shade is refreshing.  As you look at the tree, you notice the branches are
low enough that you could probably climb to the top of the tree.

rooms.name: Beneath the Oaks
rooms.desc:
You stand underneath the branches of a thick oak tree.  The coolness of the
branches and the distance from the garden trail fill you with a sense of
peacefulness.

rooms.name: Beneath the Oaks
rooms.desc:

rooms.name: On the Branches of an Oak Tree
rooms.desc:
You stand on the branches of an oak tree.  From here you can easily climb
down to the garden floor.  Looking at another tree, you see a huge birds
nest.  To get to the other tree you can jump from your branch to the 
branch with the nest.  The branches look thick enough to support your
weight and the weight of the nest.

rooms.name: Huge Bird's Nest
rooms.desc:
You are standing next to a huge birds nest.  The size of the nest would
indicate that the bird that built it would be enormous.  A strong breeze
russels the leaves above.  Is that the giant bird.  Perhaps you shouldn't
be here if it is.

rooms.name: Pixie Lair

material is draped over the back and armrests.
